messages:
maria: Quick update — opened PR that implements the KV-cache routing change but I'm leaving it blocked until the RFC is updated and arch has signed off. PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/9876 RFC: https://redwood-internal/rfcs/1213 Targeting the Tue deploy window; can't merge w/out RFC ack.

alex: quick Q — which parts of the RFC still need edits? I remember we added the fallback policy last week.

maria: fallback text is there, but the runtime key-format change + migration steps aren't in the RFC. Also need explicit canary/rollout plan and perf numbers called out.

raj: tagging reviewers: @alex can you take perf/benchmark bits? @eva can you review rollout/migration? @sam for infra sizing.

alex: I can do perf review by EOD tomorrow. Need the benchmark artifacts — please attach them to the PR or link to perf dashboards.

maria: added perf artifacts: https://perf.redwood/runs/3452 and summary in the PR description. TP50/TP95 numbers and cost delta included.

eva: I'm OOO in the morning, can review rollout after lunch. Quick question: does this change the cache key scheme? if so we need a migration step and compatibility notes.

maria: yes, tiny change to KV key prefix. I added migration steps in PR comments: run backfill job -> dual-read window -> cutover. Canary plan in PR: 10% for 24h -> 50% 24h -> 100%.

sam: infra note: confirm autoscaler behavior under shorter request bursts. tagging @infra-bot to run a staging smoke and load check.

infra-bot: deploy-check scheduled — staging smoke test queued (id: 8901). Expected report by ts 1805729800.

raj: plan: RFC must be updated + arch ack before merge. @alex @eva please post approvals or remaining blockers. If infra smoke is green and no blockers, aim for Tue deploy window. :thumbsup: 

alex: left a small inline suggestion, not a blocker.

eva: LGTM for rollout/migration pending infra smoke. I'll approve once infra-bot reports success.

maria: thanks — filing a tiny RFC patch to capture the key-format and rollout steps: https://redwood-internal/rfcs/1213/patch-3 I'll ping this thread when smoke is green and RFC patch lands.
